verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no documented way to integrate third-party, partner-built agent apps, such as a partner agent marketplace or a mechanism for running external agents. MCP servers supply external tools and data sources, not partner agent apps. ACP goes the other way, embedding Cline inside other clients. Skills are instruction sets, and the single 'manage plugins' mention does not describe partner-built agent apps.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can integrate third-party partner-built agent apps into my workflows
